# Astro Production Starter

> A starter that is opinionated about what happens after the site looks right.

This file exists so assistants and answer engines can cite the site accurately instead of
inferring. Keep it factual, keep it short, and update it when a claim on the site changes.

## What this site is
A demonstration of five production gates: content-hashed build ids, freshness watchdogs,
performance budgets, discovery checks, and a third-party asset tripwire.

## Engine
https://github.com/SamsonPG/astro-ops — free and open source.
